Content.SourceString: 近日，普雷顿地区发生了多起突发事件，出现了一些“异样”的感染人群。为了寻找解决方案，欧泊官方正在调查事件的起因。
Content.LocalizedString: Multiple incidents involving abnormally infected individuals have been reported in Preton. P.U.S authorities are investigating the cause of the incidents in order to find a solution.

Content.SourceString: 现面向广大市民征集关于弦序列紊乱的线索与情报，如有信息提供，请联系欧泊异常事务调查局。
Content.LocalizedString: The public is asked to provide clues and intelligence regarding the string sequence disruption. If you have any information, please contact the P.U.S Bureau of Anomalous Affairs.

Content.SourceString: 物资发放相关事宜：市民以家庭为单位，使用通讯设备向调查局上报成员信息，欧泊官方工作人员会在每日18：00前将防护物资送至指定区域。
Content.LocalizedString: Regarding the distribution of supplies, citizens are asked to report their household information to the BAA using communication devices. P.U.S officials will deliver protective supplies to designated areas by 6 p.m. daily.

Content.SourceString: 区域限制通知：即日起，将对普雷顿城内的危险区域进行封锁，请普通市民注意避开限制路线。
Content.LocalizedString: Area Restriction Notice: Effective immediately, dangerous areas within Preton will be sealed off. Citizens are advised to avoid restricted routes.

Content.SourceString: 下面播报多则寻人启事：男，22岁，身高约一米八，戴黑框眼镜，左手手臂有圆形胎记，穿黑色冲锋衣，于3月30日晚在普雷顿西铁区城郊列车站附近失踪，提供线索者必有重谢。联系方式：XXXXX
Content.LocalizedString: Next up, we have multiple missing person reports: Male, 22 years old, approximately 1.8 meters tall, wearing black-framed glasses, has a circular birthmark on his left arm, dressed in a black tactical jacket, went missing near the Ironwest Station on the night of March 30. A reward is offered for information on the missing person's whereabouts. Contact information: XXXXX

Content.SourceString: 关于减少特殊时期大型活动的号召：为保障市民安全，原定于本周日在艾顿城奥菲斯音乐大厅举办的“金色弦音”演奏会将取消，票款会通过原购买渠道返回。因此造成的不便，我们深表歉意。
Content.LocalizedString: Call to reduce large-scale events during this unprecedented period: In the interest of public safety, the Golden String concert originally scheduled for this Sunday at Orpheus Music Hall in Arton City has been canceled. Tickets will be refunded via the original payment methods. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

Content.SourceString: 弦序列紊乱事件逐步升级，目前，已被锚定为S级安全危机“晶源感染”。望广大市民理解并配合官方工作，面对危机，合作互助才是唯一的解决方法。
Content.LocalizedString: The string sequence disruption incident has escalated and is now classified as an S-level security crisis, aka Outbreak. Citizens are urged to cooperate with official efforts. In the face of this crisis, collaboration and mutual aid are the only solutions.

Content.SourceString: 异形清缴者招募：为应对危机，欧泊官方将增设多支清缴小队，执行探索、战斗、防护等多项职能。现面向广大市民招募志愿者，报名及后续审核工作请联系乌尔比诺紧急事务应对中心。
Content.LocalizedString: Alien Purger recruitment: P.U.S authorities are establishing additional purge squads for exploration, combat, and protection missions. Volunteers from the public are welcome to apply. Registration and interviewing will be handled by the Urbino Emergency Response Center.

Content.SourceString: 晶石粉末回收：随着粉尘浓度下降，部分近郊区域发现少量被析出的晶石粉末。如果在地面发现如下图所示的异化晶体碎片，请立即联系欧泊调查局，将有专业工作人员前来收集样本。
Content.LocalizedString: Crystallized powder recovery: As dust concentration declines, traces of crystallized powder have been found in some suburban areas. If you discover mutated crystal fragments, as shown in the image, please contact the BAA immediately. A response team will be dispatched to collect samples.

Content.SourceString: 经卡丘气象局检测，一周内普雷顿地区粉尘浓度呈下降趋势，峰值浓度从36%降至2%，平均浓度为3.94%，空气质量指数优。
Content.LocalizedString: According to the Strinova Meteorological Bureau, the dust concentration in Preton has shown a downward trend over the past week, with peak levels dropping from 36% to 2% and an average concentration of 3.94%. The air quality index is excellent.

Content.SourceString: 此次的“晶源感染”危机已基本接近尾声，本周日，欧泊将在埃利蒙德召开新闻发布会，对危机事件进行信息公开与全面复盘，广大市民可通过线上报名参与直播观看。
Content.LocalizedString: The Outbreak crisis is nearing its conclusion. This Sunday, P.U.S will hold a press conference in Elmond to disclose information and conduct a full review of the incident. Citizens are welcome to register online to watch the live broadcast.

Content.SourceString: 普雷顿地区的封锁已经解除，原定于下月举办的卡丘夺旗锦标赛将正常举行。乌尔比诺下属星庇所将提供特殊支持，参赛选手可前往进行免费的身体健康检查。
Content.LocalizedString: The lockdown in Preton has been lifted. The Strinova Capture-the-Flag Championship, scheduled for next month, will proceed as planned. Astral Sanctuary, a subsidiary of Urbino, will provide special support, offering free check-ups for participants.
